Tab label of a consistency check pair

Source: R/page-internal_consistency--consistency_check.R
consistency_pair_label.Rd

Gives the label of one indicator pair's tab on the Consistency checks card (consistency_check_ui()). The label is the pair's translation (the key opt_consist_<x>_<y>) when the translator has one. Otherwise it is the two indicator codes in capitals joined by "and" ("ANC1 and PENTA1").

Usage

consistency_pair_label(i18n, pair)

Arguments

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator).

pair

A character vector of two indicator codes, the first for the x axis and the second for the y axis (c("anc1", "penta1")).

Value

The label: what i18n$t() gives for the pair's key when it is translated, otherwise a character string.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# i18n is the app's translator, as a page receives it
consistency_pair_label(i18n, c("anc1", "penta1"))

# the labels of every pair the app compares, named by tab key
pairs <- cd_cfg("consistency_pairs", list(c("anc1", "penta1"), c("penta1", "penta3")))
labels <- vapply(pairs, function(pair) consistency_pair_label(i18n, pair), character(1))
setNames(labels, consistency_pair_keys())
} # }
